minutes.headline: Board delayed the Unifier festival license to May 16 and approved a June 14 police cruise night.
minutes.summary: The Select Board heard an entertainment license request for a multi-day festival at a private property and asked for review by the Board of Health, the chiefs, conservation and the land use director before deciding. It approved a police relief association cruise night. It reviewed Town Meeting warrant articles on conveying town buildings, the bylaw changes and the tax title lien sale or foreclosure options. The board set a workshop for May 9, heard committee reports and the town manager's first-hundred-days report, then adjourned.

what_happened.line: The Select Board delayed a decision on the Unifier festival entertainment license and asked the applicants to contact the health, public safety, conservation and land use departments first.
Applicants were told to return to the May 16 meeting.
The board voted to approve the police relief association cruise night on June 14, with resident access kept open.
A workshop on the tax title and foreclosure lists was set for the May 9 meeting; the treasurer will wait for the board's direction before sending letters.
The board reviewed Town Meeting articles on conveying town buildings without resolving them; a recommendation will come at Town Meeting.

why_it_matters: The tax title and foreclosure choice, selling liens or foreclosing, decides whether the town budget, mostly taxes, bears foreclosure costs or the town collects overdue taxes at no cost.
Residents will be asked at Town Meeting to vote on articles that would convey town buildings, and the board has not yet given a recommendation.

reconciliation.what: Our minutes against the minutes the town published. caption_error = the same fact the captions rendered badly, resolved by the official reading shown beside the as-heard one; discrepancy = a substantive difference, flagged and not resolved. Neither record is treated as the referee.
reconciliation.summary: The records agree on the main items: the $45,000 transfer, the cruise night vote, the executive session postponement, the 15-minute pre-Town Meeting meeting, and most dollar figures. They differ on the cruise night condition about resident access, who consults the departments on the entertainment license, and the attendee names. Our captions misheard several names, such as Tolson, Long and Moreno.
